name: Poland
regulation: Rozporządzenie w sprawie warunków technicznych, jakim powinny odpowiadać budynki i ich usytuowanie (Dz.U. 2022 poz. 1225)
authority: Minister Infrastruktury (now Minister Rozwoju i Technologii)
scope_note: Values for single-family houses (multi-family buildings: riser 175, width 1200, balustrade 1100). STATUS: ISAP lists this regulation as repealed from 2026-09-21; under the transition rules (Dz.U. 2026 poz. 1161) investors may design and build to it for 18 months (to about March 2028). No replacement found as of 2026-10-27. The going is a formula (2h + s = 600-650 mm) and the balustrade has only a minimum (900), so neither is checked.

stair.riser.max.note: Single-family and farm houses, two-level apartments; 175 mm in multi-family buildings.

stair.width.min.note: Usable width between handrails, single-family; 1200 multi-family.

room.ceiling.min.note: Rooms in residential buildings; 2200 for attic rooms in single-family houses (average height under sloped ceilings).

room.light.min.note: Window clear frame opening at least 1:8 of the floor area.

room.vent.min.note: At least 50 % of the required window area opens (without mechanical ventilation).

name: India
regulation: Model Building Bye-Laws 2016 (TCPO, Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs)
authority: TCPO / Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
scope_note: A model: states and cities issue the binding bye-laws, often based on it, and numbers vary by city. NBC 2016 was withdrawn on 2026-04-30 (replaced by the voluntary NBCS 2026). Light: 1/10 in hot-dry climates (1/6 warm-humid, 1/8 intermediate, 1/12 cold). The handrail rule has only a minimum (900), so it is not checked.

stair.riser.max.note: Residential buildings; at most 12 risers per flight.

stair.width.min.note: Residential dwellings; 750 for two-storey row housing.

room.ceiling.min.note: Floor to the lowest point of the ceiling; at least 2400 under beams.

room.light.min.note: Openings excluding doors; climate values in 4.30.1.1.

room.vent.min.note: The same openings give light and air; only the openable part counts.

name: Indonesia
regulation: PP 16/2021 Bangunan Gedung (stairs) and PP 12/2021 Perumahan (rumah tapak)
authority: Pemerintah Republik Indonesia; Kementerian PUPR Ditjen Cipta Karya
scope_note: National law; local Perda add rules and handle permits. Room values are for landed houses (rumah tapak). Stair width is set only for exit stairs, headroom was not found, and handrails are a pair at 650 and 800 mm, so those are not checked.

stair.riser.max.note: Riser 150-170 mm; at most 12 steps per landing.
